description:
Brooks Orpik made a significant impact for the Pittsburgh Penguins during the 2008 postseason, leading all players with 102 hits. One unforgettable moment came in Game 3 of the Stanley Cup Final when Orpik delivered four big hits on the same shift. Starting with a hit along the boards to stop a rush, he followed up with three more in the corner, electrifying the home crowd. Although the Penguins fell to the Red Wings that year, they would exact revenge the following season, with Orpik leading the team in hits en route to capturing his first Stanley Cup.
